test.title: Mock Test
test.note: Rules vary by state. Verify on the official Parivahan/Sarathi portal.
test.unverified: This is a practice format. Your state's real test may have a different number of questions, pass mark and time. Check Parivahan/Sarathi or your RTO.
test.i1: Each question appears on its own screen.
test.i2: You cannot go back to a previous question.
test.i3: If time runs out, the answer you have selected (if any) is submitted and the test moves on; if nothing is selected the question is marked unanswered.
test.i4: You will be asked to confirm before final submission.
test.confirm.sub: You cannot change answers after submitting.

about.title: About & Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: DriveReady India stores your settings and progress only on this device (in your browser's local storage). We do not ask for or collect Aadhaar, licence numbers, phone numbers or other sensitive data. No account is needed. If optional sync is added in future, it will be clearly opt-in. Use 'Reset all progress' in Profile to erase your data.
disclaimer: Independent practice app, not affiliated with MoRTH, Parivahan, Sarathi or any RTO. Always check official sources for current rules.
